description: This test file verifies the behavior of plugin registry management, cache handling, and memory plugin registration functions in the context of a plugin loader system. It contains unit tests for functions like resolveRuntimePluginRegistry, getCompatibleActivePluginRegistry, and cache clearing routines, focusing on cache reuse, secret handling, and cache invalidation.
